content:
Alternatives to instant noodle cups?
Apologies in advance if this isn't the right place to post this, but I genuinely couldn't find any other subreddit that could reasonably fit my question.

For context, I'm autistic and have ADHD and tend to struggle with the typical executive dysfunction and low energy, especially towards the evenings when I'm packing my lunch for the following day of school. About every other day I'm able to bring leftovers in my lunch, but on other days I tend to need something quick and easy to throw in there. For the past few years now, that quick and easy thing were these Mr. Noodle instant noodle cups, but recently they started to make me feel a bit sick (stomachache and nausea, y'know). So, now I'm looking for something similarly quick and easy to replace the noodle cups that can easily be prepared with only a kettle or a microwave, as both are available at my school.

In the past I've tried these microwavable cups of Hamburger Helper and KD mac and cheese, but both ended up rather flavorless and had a bit of an aftertaste. I've also tried Uncle Ben's microwave rice (the sort where you put it in for 90 seconds and it's cooked) but due to me being a bit of a picky eater and the rice tasting... well, how prepackaged rice would probably taste, there's only, like, one or two kinds that I find tolerable, and if I eat them too much I will invariably get sick of them (not literally like I did with the noodle cups, moreso just losing appetite).

Of all of the options listed, however, I would be most okay with the Uncle Ben's rice, as the few kinds I do like are really good. I just would like to know if there's anything else I could try. I also think it's worth mentioning that I don't care how healthy it is short of being edible and not actively poisoning me, because I already struggle somewhat with eating due to having a bit of a finnicky appetite. Basically, I don't care if it's ultra processed or whatever, because any food for me is probably healthy at this point lol

Thanks for bearing with me here

  
Edit: Thanks for all the replies and recommendations thus far! I'm trying to reply to as many as I can on my bus ride to school (I'm taking leftover Subway in my lunch today so the question of noodle cups replacements isn't a problem yet), but I know I absolutely will not be able to get to all of them despite my best efforts. Please know that I am reading as many of them as I can physically manage, even if I'm unable to write a reply. Stay awesome y'all :\]
